purpose: Schema for the terrain QA bands. No threshold is populated here. A --policy red flip is refused until COORD signs promotion and every band below carries a donor path:line evidence string.

parity.note: PORT APPROXIMATION - internal consistency only; no donor GPU A/B frame exists.

promotion.rule: red requires signed=true, signed_by, V17 READY, no V16 OPEN item changing a numeric gate, and a donor path:line evidence string on every band

S1_max_band_share.label: I
S1_max_band_share.note: A05:149; no decile/band above this share of cells

S1_min_bands_occupied.label: D
S1_min_bands_occupied.note: A05:149; at least this many of the five donor height bands occupied

S4_max_top1_share.label: I
S4_max_top1_share.note: A05:152; legal id domain is a hard gate, not this band

water_id.label: O
water_id.note: immutable donor encoding; a changed value is refused, not lowered

illegal_tile_ids.label: O
illegal_tile_ids.note: hard count; legal domain must be cited from the donor preset/atlas

alphanull_ids.label: O
alphanull_ids.note: zero-coverage ids; any stamp is a hard FAIL

k_ravine_1.note: absent from donor_patterns.json; never stamped and never a PASS

catalogue.note: Populate only from donor-cited derived assets; null means the corresponding subcheck stays UNVERIFIED, never PASS.

not_gates.note: A11/A05 §4.2.1 direction bands (BV32 150-270, grad 1-2, luma std 18-22, saturation ~0.53) are corroboration only, never gates.

seed_manifest_shape.generation: object of pinned config keys echoed into dump.meta (random_seed, map_w, map_h, map_type, ...)
seed_manifest_shape.capture: object of pinned camera/display keys (not byte-changing)
seed_manifest_shape.meta_key_alias: optional object mapping a config key to its dump.meta key spelling
seed_manifest_shape.run_integrity: optional object {a:{status,script_error_lines,result_mtime_after_start},b:{...},assert_clean:{verdict}} supplied by COORD; never inferred from a dump

forbidden: inventing a band or donor constant
converting UNVERIFIED to PASS without signed evidence
any donor-parity claim without a real donor GPU A/B frame
git reset --hard or any blanket restore
